## Summary

Tried to verify the user's claim that initiatives all started in different sessions and could NOT, which is itself the finding: all 38 initiative_created events in this repo carry session `cli`, the sentinel sofar new stamps because it is a CLI command with no MCP pin. So the record cannot answer which session opened an initiative, and session-orientation 2.1 must not assume it can — either it settles for most-recently-ACTIVE, which core/warmth.ts already answers, or sofar new starts attributing creation to the calling session, which helps only from the day it lands since history is never rewritten. What IS measurable and supports Phase 1 empirically: 28 of 160 sessions are registered in more than one record, about one in six, so mis-homing is the normal outcome rather than a rare mishap — though that figure is a ceiling on the problem and not a measure of harm, since record-integrity graded splits by liveness and accepted ended ones as settled. Both recorded in session-orientation with a 2.4 to add. My first measurement of this was meaningless and was corrected rather than reported.
